### Tuition fee information, payment methods and more information about financial matters.

### Scam alert! Scammers are targeting university students in Vietnam with sophisticated schemes.

Stay informed

### Fees and Charges

The Student Fees and Charges Guide (PDF, 803KB, 65p) explains how fees are set and what the various charges are for the 2025 academic year. The Guide includes information about non-academic fees (such as international insurance fees and Vietnam insurance fees) and other administrative fees (such as transcript fees, graduation fees, and photocopying fees).

A list of the indicative total program fees, calculated at today's course costs, can be viewed under Tuition Fees. Students can view their fees, download invoices and make online payments via the Financial Account tile in myRMIT.

Note: RMIT reserves the right to adjust program tuition fees to take into account increases in University and program delivery costs. All fee increases are subject to approval by the RMIT Board of Directors.

### Paying your fees

Information regarding how to pay for your fees and the methods of payment available.

### Defer a payment

RMIT has strict payment and enrolment deadlines. However, we also understand that there may be exceptional cases that make it appropriate for a payment plan to be approved.

### Tuition fees FAQ and support

Get the support you need and answers to frequently asked questions about tuition fees.

### How to apply for a refund

Learn the eligibility criteria and the procedure on how to apply for a refund.

### Health insurance

At RMIT Vietnam, your health and wellbeing matter. Having health insurance ensures you are supported with medical care during your studies.

### Tax invoices

Your invoice lists all your current fees, charges and due dates.
